dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: We sure burned through a lot of ammo back there... Ha, my gun's still hot to the touch.

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: I'll stay here to take care of my gun. Why don't you join me and rest up too?

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: Guns need rest... Just like people, right?
